audit.target: Arcane Ally November 13 local update: selected dependency maintenance
limitations: Readiness applies to the selected dependency maintenance and inspected artifact, not a full application security audit.
No production exploit testing was performed; public smoke checks were signed out and read-only.
Exact-revision Bastet build, copied-database preflight, backup, installed package read-back and post-deployment checks passed.
Affected package inventory was confirmed; app-specific exploitability was not inferred from advisory severity.

findings.title: Known affected runtime dependency versions were locked
findings.root_cause: The starting locks retained affected proxy-addr, Engine.IO, Multer, qs, body-parser and Zod versions.
findings.impact: The packages include availability and trusted-proxy defects with configuration-dependent applicability. No application-wide exploitability claim is made.
findings.recommended_fix: Use compatible patched resolutions, remove unused client resolver/validation dependencies, install from reviewed lockfiles and run regression checks plus fresh audits.
findings.safe_reproduction: Four of six bounded package behavior tests fail with the original installed server libraries and pass with the candidate. No production service or campaign was used.
findings.regression_test_evidence: server/test/dependencySecurity.test.js: six passing synthetic package/loopback cases; both candidate production audits report zero findings.
limitations: Patched runtime versions were verified in production on November 13, 2026; no application-wide security assessment is claimed.

findings.title: Known affected build and development dependency resolutions
findings.root_cause: The starting tooling graphs included affected Vite, Vitest, glob-matcher and other transitive versions; the new parser also required a scoped matcher correction.
findings.impact: Tooling can process unsafe input in the affected upstream use cases. App endpoint reachability is not established by a development dependency alert.
findings.recommended_fix: Apply compatible tooling updates and narrowly scoped minimatch 11.0.8 overrides, retain older API consumers unchanged, verify the actual consumers, and add CI audit gates.
findings.regression_test_evidence: Client tests/build/lint; twenty glob cases for each overridden consumer; TypeScript project matching, real server ESLint and Nodemon synthetic-child smoke; both full candidate audits report zero findings.
limitations: The compatibility probes cover this application's inspected consumers, not all consumers of minimatch major 11.
